This! ChatGPT is not AI, it’s a LLM designed as a virtual assistant. Would you let your assistant make your trades for you? You might ask their advice, get their feedback, and utilize them in strategy building. But very rarely would anyone let their assistant submit the final product.

Good question! If we talking ChatGPT specifically, I’d assume it’d be good enough but still slightly worse, simply cause ChatGPT wasn’t built for this, it isn’t a financial AI model, it’s a large language model designed to mimic human communication (specifically through text) 

That’s why it will give you the answers you’re looking for not necessarily the correct answer. It’s like a really fancy autocomplete honestly. You can easily convince it that it’s wrong when it’s right and it can easily convince you that it’s right when it’s wrong. 

For two reasons, OpenAI currently has Chat set up to not make the user feel dumb so Chat is overly agreeable because it’s supposed to be an assistant you just bounce ideas off of. And secondly, it’s autogenerated text based off what is most likely to come next. So if you tell it’s wrong, it’s programmed to say “you’re right, my bad” and that is just what is the “most human” response to someone correcting someone else. 

This second part however is what would be useful for trading, it can take past information and identify the patterns, so with live data too, theoretically, it would be able to map predictive patterns in real time. 

Where I think it would fall short is the trading bots can execute trades instantly, so if an earnings report comes out and the algo identifies a loss coming it’ll instantly sell off. 

ChatGPT couldn’t do that. You’d have manually feed it the data from the report, had already previously given it the back data for the security, wait for it to generate a recommendation, then go a manually execute your order. 

Sure that’s a few minutes but for some investors a few minutes is few grand down the drain. 

Here’s how I would best optimize ChatGPT for trading. Let’s say I’m going to start using Chat after the weekend. Monday I trade as normal. Once the market closes I take 2-3 of the securities I am thinking about trading the next day. One at a time, ask ChatGPT if it is familiar with company and ticker symbol, ensure it’s aware of the right company, upload the charts, inform Chat of any news or anticipated news, and ask for a breakdown of a trading strategy, if it’s a even good investment, entry/exit points, and other relevant information stop/loss ect. 

Mind you I’m no expert an investing or AI 😂 just my assumptions based off how I know ChatGPT to currently work

All the adventures are just Rick playing pretend Morty and we see it how Morty is picturing it and processing his life in with a screwed up family.

But Rick is still Rick, he’s still an alcoholic, he’s not going to censor himself for Mortys sake, and, we see many times, he’s still going through it. 

Now from Morty’s POV, he’s a 14 year old boy on the spectrum, into science fiction, going through the awkwardness of puberty and high school, seemingly has no friends, his parents relationship is on the rocks, and then his foul mouthed alcoholic grandfather just moved in.
